intro: Your seat of power deserves more. The Orient Plush Chair pairs quilted upholstery, ergonomic support, and sleek styling—keeping you comfortable, confident, and in command all day.

features.title: Style that means business
features.text: Your workspace deserves a chair that reflects authority. Clean lines, sculpted curves, and a refined silhouette make every corner look sharper, smarter, and more professional.

features.title: Flexibility that works with you
features.text: Your comfort is never static. The centre tilt mechanism with tension control lets you recline to recharge or lock upright when focus calls—adjusting effortlessly to your needs.

features.title: Built-in comfort for your spine
features.text: Your posture stays protected with built-in lumbar support that distributes weight evenly, keeps pressure off your spine, and helps you stay comfortable for long hours.

features.title: Set it up, your way
features.text: From height adjustment to a 2-position lock, the chair adapts to your body. Upright for deep work, reclined for reflection so your comfort stays in your control.

features.title: Comfort you can sink into
features.text: Plush quilted upholstery gives cushioning that lasts. The even weight distribution eases pressure points, so you stay fresh, supported, and relaxed all day long.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
